Emergency department note, document date 2026-10-04: On 2026-10-02 the patient had a spontaneous gastrointestinal bleeding event while taking apixaban. This was not related to surgery or any other invasive procedure. Hemoglobin decreased from 12.4 g/dL on 2026-09-30 to 8.9 g/dL on 2026-10-03, a 3.5 g/dL fall, and he received two units of packed red cells. This episode is expressly classified as a major bleeding event because it meets both the hemoglobin-drop and transfusion criteria.

He presented with marked fatigue and lightheadedness, and the initial assessment showed low blood pressure compared with his usual readings. Apixaban was held, intravenous fluids were given, and he was admitted for monitoring after transfusion.
